svg.text: $ ipa-diagnose client --user alice --service sshd (exit 1)
REAL LIVE CAPTURE - FreeIPA 4.13.4 / Fedora 43 lab - commit b58f3d6, run 36742908065
ipa-diagnose client: client1.lab.test (IPA domain lab.test, server ipa01.lab.test)
LIVE; asked about user alice, service sshd; SSSD 2.12.0, IPA client 4.13.4
client1.lab.test: 2 independent problems: The SSSD configuration has errors; The configured DNS resolvers do not answer.
AUTHENTICATION FAIL online authentication against IPA fails on this host: The configured DNS resolvers do not
answer
AUTHORIZATION NOT VERIFIED not evaluated by client mode: FreeIPA's own decision comes from ipa-diagnose access USER
HOST SERVICE
RUNTIME ACCESS FAIL a login by alice through sshd is expected to fail on this host: SSSD's account check refu
ses alice through sshd
ROOT CAUSE
[PRIMARY] The SSSD configuration has errors - confidence HIGH
sssctl config-check: 1 issue(s).
Impact: SSSD may refuse to start or ignore options; restarting it does not fix this.
[INDEPENDENT] The configured DNS resolvers do not answer - confidence HIGH
ipa01.lab.test does not resolve and the resolvers in /etc/resolv.conf time out on a direct query as well: the reso
lvers (or the path to them) are down, not a single missing record.
Impact: SSSD, Kerberos and the IPA API cannot reach the server by name: IPA identities and logins fail once SSSD's
cache no longer covers them.
[RELATED] Kerberos with the host key failed (caused by The configured DNS resolvers do not answer) - confidence LOW
kinit with the host keytab failed: timeout (no answer within 20 s)
Impact: SSSD may not be able to authenticate this host.
[RELATED] SSSD is offline (caused by The configured DNS resolvers do not answer) - confidence HIGH
SSSD domain lab.test is OFFLINE; explained by: The configured DNS resolvers do not answer. SSSD log signals: offli
ne, server_unreachable.
Impact: Only cached users and groups resolve, and only users who logged in before can log in (with cached credenti
als, if enabled). New users and policy changes are not seen.
[RELATED] SSSD's account check refuses alice through sshd (caused by SSSD is offline) - confidence MEDIUM
The PAM account phase answered 'Permission denied' (access_provider = ipa). With access_provider = ipa this is Fre
eIPA HBAC (or the account state) as SSSD evaluates it on this host.
Impact: alice cannot log in here through sshd.
